title: Code and frozen results for: Patient-level differential privacy, membership leakage and explanation fidelity in federated brain tumour MRI classification
description:
Code, run configurations, per-run results, frozen tables (results/FROZEN_MANIFEST, SHA-256 hashes), figure data, split and duplicate manifests, Kaggle launcher notebooks and the LaTeX manuscript source for a study of record-level and patient-level differential privacy in federated brain tumour MRI classification on a deduplicated Figshare, SARTAJ and Br35H benchmark, with likelihood-ratio membership inference audits and Grad-CAM explanation evaluation.

No MRI images are included except small illustrative panels in figures. The images come from the cited public collections, and data_manifest/ records every source file, hash and split needed to rebuild the curated set with notebooks 01 to 03.
